news.title: French President visits national team ahead of World cup
news.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron and First Lady Brigitte Macron visited the country's national football team ahead of their departure for the World Cup. France are one of the favourites going into the competition. This will be the final major tournament for head coach Didier Deschamps, after 14 years in charge of the national team.
news.source: France 24 - International breaking news, top stories and headlines
